Distortion pit alert 🖤⚡ Les-Be-Emo is crashing into Azucar's Patio and it's about to get LOUD. Summerache, Porch Cat, and Moonstruck are bringing the riffs, DJ Dea keeps the night bleeding between sets, and Ember Rexia hosts a drag show at 8PM that you do NOT want to miss. Live bands. Drag. Night market. Flannel required (kidding, but also not really). This is your one shot at this lineup — mark it, set a reminder, tell your people. Feel the bass rattle through the Patio before you even see the stage 🎸🖤 Fog rolling off the amps, riffs from Summerache, Porch Cat, and Moonstruck stacking on top of each other, DJ Dea bleeding the night into something electric. Smudged eyeliner, flannel sleeves rolled up, the smell of night-market snacks drifting through smoky red lights. Ember Rexia struts the stage for a drag show that hits at 8PM sharp — sequins catching every flash of light like broken glass. This isn't background noise, it's a full-body experience. You'll feel it in your chest before the first chorus even drops. 🦇⚡

Come exactly as you are — flannel, fishnets, band tees, smudged black eyeliner, whatever feels like you. Les-Be-Emo is a mini feastival built for anyone who's ever screamed a lyric into their pillow at 2am, and Azucar's Patio is the place to do it out loud. Summerache, Porch Cat, and Moonstruck are here for the riffs, DJ Dea is here to keep it moving, and Ember Rexia hosts a drag show at 8PM that's all heart and all fire. Live bands, a night market to browse between sets, and a crowd that gets it. No pretending, no performing — just community, noise, and glitter under the same sky. This one's for the misfits, the moshers, and everyone in between. 🖤🎸🦇
